# Quantum Dark Direction Receiver

Task: estimate wholly unknown f in CP2 from iid rho_f=(I-P_f)/2, minimizing worst-case expected dark-ray infidelity. Exact rank2, equal populations and known lab reference are promises.

Read science/model.md first. science/collective-minimax.md gives exact collective risk for a uniform codimension-one source in any dimension and at every specimen budget. science/measurement-hierarchy.md solves the three-qutrit joint, effectwise biseparable, fixed-cut and sequential pair-plus-single optima. science/finite-budget.md provides the two-copy tie and the rational adaptive-one-copy bound. science/implementation.md makes the MUB receiver's random setting and control precision finite. science/receiver.md owns fixed24/450 POVMs and Hodge outcome labels. science/one-copy-bound.md gives the global finite adaptive lower. science/memory-noise.md proves a global spectral-estimator bound; science/calibration.md charges all independent references, rejection and systematic readout-error bounds. science/limits.md states coherent exchange ambiguity and entanglement-breaking simulation.

references/RELATED_WORK.md credits Keyl/PSW, Zhu-Hayashi, Navascues, bounded-copy tomography and experimental precedents. The measurement architecture and ideal matrix estimator are inherited. No arbitrary hardware-noise guarantee or time/cost saving follows.

verification/README.md describes exact and numerical checks. verification/check_finite_budget.py uses SymPy and the saved rational certificate, with no SDP optimizer. Monte Carlo baseline comparisons are explicitly selected-strategy evidence.

Learning: one selected anchor, Demkowicz-Dobrzanski–Gorecki–Guta2020arXiv2001.11742v2. learning/README.md routes learning/STORY.md, learning/ANCHOR.md and exactly30intrinsic targets in learning/MILESTONES.md (12background+18narrative). Personal coaching and learner records are not in this repository.
